name: bsv-storage-cloudflare
description: UHRP file hosting on Cloudflare R2 with BRC-103/104 authentication, BRC-29 payments and public downloads.

capabilities.paymentTransportNote: Payment must be sent as JSON in the x-bsv-payment header; body mode (x-bsv-payment: body) is not supported.

endpoints.description: Build provenance and health message; / is an alias.
Quote a file size and retention period in satoshis without authentication or payment.
Return a presigned R2 PUT URL and required headers for a paid upload; PUT the bytes directly to R2.

payment.description: Send the authenticated request without payment to receive a signed 402 with the exact satoshi amount, then retry with payment JSON in the x-bsv-payment header; body mode is not supported.

endpoints.description: Pay to extend an existing advertisement using its recorded file size; any authenticated identity may renew.

payment.description: Send the authenticated request without payment to receive a signed 402 with the exact satoshi amount, then retry with payment JSON in the x-bsv-payment header; body mode is not supported.

endpoints.description: Find metadata for a UHRP URL belonging to the authenticated uploader.
List files belonging to the authenticated uploader.
Create a UHRP advertisement; the authenticated identity must also be in ADMIN_IDENTITY_KEYS.

formula_notes.retentionPeriod: minutes (1 month = 43,200 = 60*24*30); examples use 525,600 minutes (365 days)
formula_notes.bsvUsdRate: Live from WhatsOnChain; fallback 15 USD/BSV on a failed fetch or invalid rate
formula_notes.rounding: floor, then the minimum satoshi price

pricing.note: Live from WhatsOnChain; fallback 15 USD/BSV on a failed fetch or invalid rate. bsv_usd and all examples use one call to the quote's rate fetch. Use /quote for current pricing; this unsigned manifest may be cached for 300 seconds. No additional margin multiplier is applied to PRICE_PER_GB_MO. USD examples are before the satoshi minimum. MIN_HOSTING_MINUTES supplies the configured lower bound (missing, unparseable or NaN values become zero). /quote requires positive integer file sizes and integer, nonzero retention and caps retention; /upload caps file size but does not enforce that retention maximum or integer retention. /quote does not enforce the upload size cap.

publicUrlFormat.note: Replace {base58id} with the last segment of the object key in uploadURL, a base58 encoding of 16 random bytes; public downloads use PUBLIC_URL_BASE after the object is uploaded.
